title: How temporary inbox deletion actually works
excerpt: When a temporary inbox expires, the Redis key holding it is evicted and the mail is unrecoverable. A walkthrough of the full lifecycle, from creation to eviction.
meta_title: How temporary inbox deletion actually works
meta_description: Temporary inboxes live only in Redis with a TTL — when it lapses, mail is unrecoverable. How expiry, extensions, and the 100-message cap actually work.
